boards.title: What the Campus Tour Skips: 10 Places Students Share With Each Other
boards.description: Ten Emmanuel College spaces with specific uses for quiet work, group projects, creative production, commuter breaks, and time between classes.

cards.title: Settle In for Quiet Research
cards.subtitle: Individual carrels, computers and collaborative spaces
cards.notes: Choose an individual carrel for focused work, or move to the collaboration areas when an assignment calls for conversation.
cards.short_summary: A sunlit library that supports both concentrated study and collaborative research.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel states that Cardinal Cushing Library provides study and collaboration space, group rooms, individual carrels and computer stations.
cards.source_title: Cardinal Cushing Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Library resources and spaces serve the Emmanuel College community; confirm current building hours before visiting.

cards.title: Prototype More Than Papers
cards.subtitle: The makerspace inside Cardinal Cushing Library
cards.notes: Bring a creative assignment here when you need fabrication or media tools; ask library staff about equipment access and training first.
cards.short_summary: A campus makerspace for fabrication, imaging and hands-on digital work.
cards.evidence_claim: The college identifies DiscoveryLab as a library makerspace with tools including 3D printers, professional camera equipment, laser cutters and Adobe software.
cards.source_title: Cardinal Cushing Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Located inside Cardinal Cushing Library; equipment access may require staff assistance, training or advance arrangements.

cards.entity_name: Library Learning Commons Group Study Rooms
cards.title: Reserve the Conversation
cards.subtitle: Bookable rooms in the Library Learning Commons
cards.notes: Book through the Student Resources area of MySaints up to two weeks ahead when your group needs a defined place to talk.
cards.short_summary: Reservable library rooms give small groups a dedicated place to work aloud.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel says Library Learning Commons group study spaces may be booked up to two weeks in advance through the MySaints Portal.
cards.source_title: Study Spots & Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Students reserve these spaces through the MySaints Portal; current availability and reservation rules apply.

cards.title: Work at the Campus Crossroads
cards.subtitle: Flexible seating on the Jean Yawkey Center’s lower level
cards.notes: Use the lower-atrium seating for a between-class work session when you want to remain close to dining and student services.
cards.short_summary: A central seating area suited to shorter study sessions between campus commitments.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel’s study-spaces page specifically notes that the Jean Yawkey Center lower atrium has plentiful seating for schoolwork.
cards.source_title: Study Spots & Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Available when the Jean Yawkey Center is open; the area is shared and may be active during campus programming.

cards.title: Take the Project Upstairs
cards.subtitle: The second-floor atrium overlooking the Quad
cards.notes: Meet here for collaborative assignments when your group benefits from open seating and a central location overlooking the Quad.
cards.short_summary: An upper-level atrium where students can read, write and collaborate in groups.
cards.evidence_claim: The college says the Jean Yawkey Center’s sunny second-floor Maureen Murphy Wilkens Atrium overlooks the Quad and is used for group assignments.
cards.access_notes: Available to the Emmanuel community while the Jean Yawkey Center is open; events may affect seating.

cards.title: Build a Base Between Classes
cards.subtitle: A dedicated commuter space in the Jean Yawkey Center
cards.notes: Use this lounge as a daytime base for pauses between classes, then branch out to nearby dining, study seating or activities.
cards.short_summary: A named campus lounge that gives commuting students a consistent place to land.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel identifies the Commuter Lounge as a Jean Yawkey Center resource for commuter students.
cards.access_notes: Intended for Emmanuel commuter students and accessible according to Jean Yawkey Center building rules.

cards.title: Shift Your Study Session to Julie Hall
cards.subtitle: First-floor study space in Saint Julie Hall
cards.notes: Try the Plaza Lounge when the library setting does not fit the task and you want another shared study option on campus.
cards.short_summary: An all-student first-floor study area inside Saint Julie Hall.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel lists the Plaza Lounge among Saint Julie Hall’s first-floor study spaces available to all students.
cards.source_title: Study Spots & Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: The college says this first-floor space is available to all students; Saint Julie Hall access procedures still apply.

cards.title: Find Another First-Floor Work Zone
cards.subtitle: Shared study space inside Saint Julie Hall
cards.notes: Bring independent reading or a low-key group task here when you need an alternative to the main library and student center.
cards.short_summary: A named Saint Julie Hall lounge designated for student study.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel names the Brookline Avenue Lounge as one of Saint Julie Hall’s first-floor study spaces available to all students.
cards.source_title: Study Spots & Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Available to Emmanuel students subject to Saint Julie Hall entry rules and any scheduled use of the lounge.

cards.title: Move Media Work Into Its Own Space
cards.subtitle: A first-floor resource in Saint Julie Hall
cards.notes: Use this named media space when a project calls for a setting beyond a standard desk; verify equipment procedures before arriving.
cards.short_summary: A dedicated media-oriented space within Saint Julie Hall’s student-accessible first floor.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel identifies the Margaret L. McKenna '83 Media Center among Saint Julie Hall’s first-floor spaces available to students.
cards.source_title: Study Spots & Library at Emmanuel College
cards.access_notes: Located on Saint Julie Hall’s first floor; confirm current access and equipment-use requirements with the college.

cards.entity_name: Maureen Murphy Wilkens Science Center Common Areas
cards.title: Study Alongside the Labs
cards.subtitle: Solo and group work areas in the science center
cards.notes: Choose a common area here for solo review or group problem-solving, especially when your classes already bring you into the building.
cards.short_summary: Science-center common areas extend academic work beyond classrooms and laboratories.
cards.evidence_claim: Emmanuel states that the Wilkens Science Center includes meeting space and common areas for solo and group study.
cards.access_notes: For Emmanuel community use while the academic building is open; classrooms and laboratories may have separate restrictions.
